allowed_claim: Draft design clarification only: it proposes conservative counting semantics but does not freeze, activate, or make the R6 web allowance executable or countable.

adapter_dispatch_accounting.web_policy_relation_to_tool_ceilings: ALL_LIMITS_APPLY; aggregate web_search plus web_fetch reservations must be at most 2, while each operation also remains below its own tool ceiling

common_rejections: Codex click, find, image_query, literature_search_query, screenshot, finance, weather, sports, or time options
Codex domain or recency query options outside the exact common host field
caller-selected response length, freshness, cache, headers, cookies, auth, method, form, upload, retry, replay, reconciliation, status query, fallback, MCP, bytedcli, or ByteDance-internal option

provider_treatment_boundary.controlled_common_inputs: logical operation, one logical item, exact query or URL, exact official-host set, fixed extraction prompt, adapter-dispatch ceilings, argument/body/time bounds, no caller extras, and failure accounting
provider_treatment_boundary.internal_differences: provider ranking, index, retrieval planning, internal HTTP behavior, redirects not exposed to the adapter, retries not exposed to the adapter, caching, rendering, extraction, and response representation remain provider treatment internals
provider_treatment_boundary.reporting_rule: record each observable internal fact; record unavailable otherwise; never silently claim equality or convert an unavailable internal into a matched control
provider_treatment_boundary.scientific_basis: the frozen design defines native web-search capability differences as provider treatment while requiring identical logical allowances and budgets

web_fetch.exact_extraction_prompt: Return a bounded rendered extract of the requested public document. Preserve literal wording needed for source verification, state when content is unavailable, and do not infer facts absent from the fetched page.
web_fetch.input: one exact HTTPS URL plus the exact extraction prompt; no other caller field

url_policy.host: one exact ASCII hostname from the independently reviewed allowlist
url_policy.redirect_or_final_origin: success requires every exposed hop and final hostname to be exact allowlist members; unavailable redirect or final-origin evidence is UNKNOWN_NO_REPLAY, not matchedness

web_search.input: one non-empty UTF-8 query plus one exact independently reviewed official-host set and one fixed positive result ceiling; no other caller field
web_search.result_host_rule: every accepted result URL must have an exact allowlisted ASCII hostname; provider wildcard or implicit-subdomain semantics cannot substitute

clarification_target.ambiguity: WEB_POLICY.call_ceiling=2 has no source-defined counter unit or relationship to TOOL_POLICY web_search=2 and web_fetch=6.
clarification_target.proposed_interpretation: WEB_POLICY.call_ceiling is the aggregate per-cell adapter-dispatch-reservation ceiling across web_search and web_fetch; operation ceilings remain independent upper bounds.

driver_contracts.status: DISABLED_PROVIDER_FREE_CANDIDATES; exact live provider schema/readback not established

frozen_predecessor.preservation: v1 remains immutable OPEN history; no v1 file is superseded or activated

open_requirements_before_any_executable_: an additive owner-reviewed source-authority artifact must name every exact ASCII official hostname; the frozen payload and cutoff name source classes only, so no host may be guessed
the R6 design owner must independently review and explicitly adopt or reject the proposed aggregate WEB_POLICY counter semantics
the design must freeze a numeric search-result ceiling distinct from dispatch ceilings and define adapter-side enforcement
each adapter must expose or fail closed on final URL/origin and redirect evidence required by the exact-host rule
the exact external tool schemas and versions accepted by the bound Claude and Codex binaries must be pinned and read back; documentation and source-to-binary identity gaps remain
the fixed fetch prompt, argument/body/time bounds, caller-extra rejection, and UNKNOWN/no-replay behavior must be expressed in one closed successor contract and independently reviewed
